title: Understanding Angular Acceleration
text: Angular acceleration is the rate of change of angular velocity over time. It is similar to linear acceleration but in rotational motion.

title: Relating Linear and Angular Quantities
text: The linear speed of the bicycle is related to the angular speed of the wheels by the formula: $$v=r\omega$$, $$where$$ $$v$$ $$is$$ $$the$$ $$linear$$ $$speed$$, $$r$$ is the radius, and $$\omega$$ is the angular speed.

title: Finding Angular Speed
text: To find the angular speed $$\omega$$ at the final speed, use the formula: $$\omega=\frac{v}{r}$$.

title: Calculate Final Angular Speed
text: Given the final linear speed $$v=10.0\, \tfrac{\text{m}}{\text{s}}$$ and radius $$r=0.3\, \text{m}$$, $$calculate$$ $$the$$ $$final$$ $$angular$$ $$speed$$ $$\omega$$.
